_about: Generated from quantum-validation 0.3.1 in quip-validator at commit 2ca50ee on 2026-09-23.
Pins integer diversity, greedy selection indices and ties, and proof gate outcomes and statistics.

Random sets use ChaCha8 seed [7;32], with proof sets continuing after the 60 diversity sets. Selection inputs reference the diversity array by diversity_case. Proof cases include malformed widths and spins. Zero-width solutions are covered only by Rust unit tests because chain diversity divides by zero.
Generator source is described in docs/coordinator-upgrade-v2.md (Task 12).
